environment.description: Same Flask application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The task runs with a read-only root filesystem (readonlyRootFilesystem: true in the ECS task definition). The container image does not mount any writable volumes — there is no ephemeral storage, no EFS mount, and no bind mount configured. The /tmp directory exists in the container image layer but is not writable at runtime. The task execution role has no S3 or EFS permissions. Container healthcheck hits /health endpoint.

config.note: ephemeralStorage in Fargate is only accessible if explicitly mounted; readonlyRootFilesystem prevents writes to container paths including /tmp unless a volume is mounted there
config.alb_rules: default forward action only, no WAF association
